entities.summary: Jaycob Dalton Megna is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman and captain for the Henderson Silver Knights of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Vegas Golden Knights of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Anaheim Ducks in the seventh round, 210th overall, of the 2012 NHL entry draft. He has also played with the San Jose Sharks, Seattle Kraken, Chicago Blackhawks, and Florida Panthers.
